rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: TANeiglat
Exhibition name: La Garçonne ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 1995).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1996 as 'Nostalgie'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, cherry-red edges, red outer petals. . Cream edged with cherry. Moderate fragrance. up to 40 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, full (26-40 petals), globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, dark green, leathery foliage.

Height: 31" to 47" (80 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
